scenes.title: Lá na Sacada (Up on the Balcony)
scenes.summary: On Friday morning, M1, M3, and F1 step onto the sunny second-floor courtyard balcony and test the original iron hooks made for festival lantern cords.

scenes.title: Pendurando Ouro Acima da Árvore (Stringing Gold Above the Tree)
scenes.summary: M3 and M4 stretch warm gold-and-coral lantern cords from the upper balcony to the courtyard shade tree while F2 directs the symmetry from below.

scenes.title: O Mapa de Mesas Principal (The Master Seating Chart)
scenes.summary: Inside Room 9, M2 proudly shows F1 and F3 his enormous hand-lettered seating poster for twenty-eight guests and refuses to make a backup copy.

scenes.title: Uma Rajada de Vento Repentina (A Sudden Gust of Wind)
scenes.summary: Stepping into the courtyard, a sudden wind gust tangles the overhead lanterns and launches M2's giant seating chart straight across the stones.

scenes.title: Flutuando na Bacia (Floating in the Basin)
scenes.summary: Lifting the soaked poster out of the stone basin, M2 despairs over the blurred blue cloud while M1 and F2 talk him back from panic.

scenes.title: Desembaraçando a Corda das Lanternas (Untangling the Lantern Cord)
scenes.summary: Back on the upper balcony, M1 and M3 reel in the twisted lantern lines and add wooden spacer loops so the globes stay steady in any breeze.

scenes.title: Vinte e Oito Prendedores de Roupa de Madeira (Twenty-Eight Wooden Clothespins)
scenes.summary: At the front desk, M1 pours out sturdy birch clothespins, and F1 numbers them one to twenty-eight in bold pencil to clip onto heavy cloth napkins.

scenes.title: À Prova de Vento e Prontos (Windproof and Ready)
scenes.summary: Just before noon on Saturday, F1, F2, and M3 admire the windproof rooftop lanterns and clipped linen tables—all set for six this evening, until the front-desk telephone rings!
